scope: 50 middle-triangle families / 1827 canonical source SVGs carrying one numeric segment label each. Cylinder nets remain root-owned.

api.export: presentArithmeticSegmentSvg(id: string, originalSvg: string): string | undefined
api.integration: Root invokes after trusted canonical validation and before typesetArithmeticGeometrySvg. Shared facade/registry/UI not edited.
api.acceptance: Full original string equality, never hash-only. Unknown IDs, tuples, versions, modified source, and already transformed SVG return undefined.

engine.curve: Offline calls existing arithmetic-dimension-presentation-engine.py bridge to vendor/figure-engine/core/figure_svg.py meas() itself.
engine.label: Actual editor curveMidpoint() positions 16-unit labels on engine curves. Actual browser bounds before and after typography jointly constrain layout.
engine.gap: Actual editor gapPolygon()/applyLineGaps() masks only dimension curves with union glyph bounds. Source geometry is never masked; no white label halo.
engine.geometry: All frozen line/path/circle elements, equal/parallel/right/angle marks retained under a uniform 1.5 transform. Point/center labels relocated locally; old leaders removed. Exterior projected dimensions have witnesses tied to exact endpoints. No numeric value derived from drawing scale.
engine.givens: Every source point and numeric label preserved exactly. Only the already published number is drawn; all other public givens and target remain in the unchanged prompt.
engine.endpointTolerance: Engine meas() intentionally offsets endpoints 1.5 virtual units in the normal direction; browser audit allows 0.13 for its one-decimal path serialization.

runtime.cache: Static compressed JSON import; per-family lazy raw-deflate/base64 decode with fflate. Import performs no inflate. Four-family LRU.
runtime.memoryQualification: Decoded JSON UTF-8 byte bound, not a claim about total JavaScript heap; strings/objects and loaded compressed data add overhead.
runtime.generation: No runtime Python, MathJax, DOM, browser layout, network, or figure generation.

validation.vitest: 5 focused tests passed, including every ID, exact byte acceptance, all marks/givens, typed idempotence, decoded rows and lazy four-family LRU eviction.
validation.typescript: Strict ES2017 targeted check passed using existing root dependencies.
validation.lint: Scoped ESLint passed; normal Husky lint-staged ESLint/Prettier are required at commit.
validation.reproduction: A complete second generation without --write reproduced checked asset bytes exactly.
validation.visualReview: Circumcenter, incenter, centroid, midsegment, similarity, Pythagoras, external bisector and three-parallel cases inspected at screen 280 and print; full 320 audit also passed.
validation.boundary: Standalone presentation/browser/print proof. Root owns application route integration and the four net families.
